第十一章 重宝到手！（二更求收）
草屋内，秦家老祖端坐在一蒲团上，眉头微皱，脸上有着一丝凝重之色，眼里不时流露出一股疑惑，闪烁着淡蓝色光芒的双手不断在黑衣少年身上扫过。
秦轩同样坐于蒲团之上，观察着四周，令他有些讶异的是，这外观看似普通的草屋，里面竟是仿若一片星空，繁星点点，似乎触手可及，而自己便坐于这片星空当中，稍微闭眼感受，便惊讶的发现，这里的玄气竟比外界浓郁至少十倍！
浓郁十倍的玄气！这是什么概念？秦轩想想都觉得头皮发麻，但随即心中便是一阵火热，若是自己呆在这里，怕是要不了多久便可突破至气海境了吧？
“怪哉怪哉！”
收回双手，淡蓝色光芒随之消散，秦家老祖连道两句，眉宇间充满了浓浓的不解。
心头猛的一揪，秦轩甚至来不及继续震撼，连忙开口问道，“老祖，难道我身体怎么了吗？”
看着少年急切的模样，老祖摇了摇头，苦笑一声，说道，“非也，你的身体不仅没事，而且身体强度远超我的想象。”
闻言，秦轩不禁松了口气，随即疑惑起来，既然没事，那老祖为何这幅神情？
“经老夫的观察，你的经脉的确断了七层有余，若是常人，怕是早已成为废人，终身都要躺在床上了。”不等少年说话，老祖继续说道，“幸运的是，你有一个恐怖的身体。”
老祖声音难掩自己心中的惊讶，若是可以，他甚至想将这具身体解剖开来，好好研究研究一番。
而以他观察，秦轩目前这具肉体已经比一般气海镜强者还要强！
“而且，老夫若是没猜错，怕是你体内已经有一股力量正在帮你修复经脉了吧？”老祖最后一句话却是带着疑惑，一双眼睛紧紧的盯着少年，似乎要将其看透一般。
微微一怔，秦轩没想到这位老祖竟然连这个都能发现，仅仅犹豫一下，便是点了点头，“没错，只是却修复得极慢。”
“这就难怪了。”
秦家老祖一副果然如此的表情，也不多问，每个人都有自己机缘，就好比如当初他自己一般，若非得到那样东西，他也不可能一手建立整个偌大的秦家。
“老祖，难道这股力量有什么不对劲的吗？”眉头一皱，秦轩心中升起一丝不好的预感，那股力量自然指的是‘英雄神典’的力量，可若不是凭借着‘英雄神典’，他也不可能一日间连晋三重啊！
要说‘英雄神典’有问题，秦轩很是难以接受。
“那倒不是。”笑着摇了摇头，老祖沉思片刻后，说道，“以目前来看，这股力量对你来说并没有害处。”
“只可惜，这股力量过于神秘，以老夫目前的实力还无法窥探一二。”老祖的嘴角带着一抹苦笑，之前不论他如何努力，就是无法破开少年体内的那层厚墙，看到里面的情形。

见此，秦轩这才终于安下心来，只要‘英雄神典’对自己无害便可了，至于老祖所说的无法窥探，其实也很好理解，毕竟‘英雄神典’可是自己由那神秘宇宙中得到的，不说秦家老祖了，就算是秦轩自己，对于‘英雄神典’也是知之甚少。
不过，这也令他对‘英雄神典’愈加期待起来！
这时，秦轩猛然察觉头顶的那片‘星空’一阵变幻，不等他反应，只见秦家老祖伸手往那‘星空’抓去。
仿若玻璃破碎，在秦轩目瞪口呆的表情下，整片‘星空’瞬间破碎，露出原来草屋简陋的模样，而老祖的手中，却是已然多了一口晶莹剔透的小钟。
之所以说它小，主要是因为这口钟只有巴掌大，质地似水晶，表面不时有一道火红的能量流过，如火焰，离得近了，更是有一股炽热的气息迎面扑来。
水晶钟滞空悬浮于老祖的手心，缓缓旋转着，不时有一道强横的能力溢出，令离得近的秦轩灵魂一阵颤抖。
“此物唤作‘离火钟’。”老祖嘴角带笑，眼里有着一丝追忆，“本想这次族府大会拿出来当做奖励，如今看来，它找到了一个更好的主人。”
“这，这就是那件重宝？”秦轩惊道，声音变得有些尖锐起来。
点了点头，老祖并没有否认，他身上的重宝不止这一件，否则也不可能如此大气，但是当初为了争夺这‘离火钟’，他也是费了九牛二虎之力，拼得重伤才夺到的。
秦轩不禁倒吸一口凉气，呼吸也变得有些急促起来，双眼紧紧的盯着眼前这口晶莹剔透的‘离火钟’，这可是重宝啊！在外界足以引起不小动静的存在啊！
这时，秦轩这时候才联想到为何之前草屋内是一副星空的模样，想来便是这重宝所致，还有那比外界浓郁近乎十倍的玄气，自从星空消失，化作‘离火钟’出现在老祖手中后，便也消失了。
“父亲曾说过，这重宝不仅可以修复经脉，而且还可提升修炼的速度，看来所言非虚。”
想想也是，带着一个比外界玄气浓郁近十倍的重宝在身上，修炼速度怎能不快？
“不过，这若是修炼至后面的境界，想必效果也就越来越小。”心中暗道一声，秦轩明白，外物虽然重要，但是自身才是关键，这也是为何老祖会将‘离火钟’贡献出来的另一个原因。
“看来秦云天那小子已经对你说过了。”
看着少年脸上的神情，老祖满意的点头，笑道，“当年为了这件重宝，老夫可谓是付出了极大的代价，更是凭借它从气海境一路成长到现在的境界，如今老夫将其送于你，不知你是否接受？”
虽然已经猜到了，但是当这句话从老祖口中说出来，秦轩依旧充满了激动与兴奋，不接受？除非脑袋被门夹了，或者被炮打了！
这可是重宝啊！
之前他还有些担心能不能从老祖手中获得这重宝，毕竟这关系到自己经脉修复得问题，而且在族府大会也说过，只有家族年轻一辈第一人才有资格获得此物。
但是现在，秦轩彻底安心了，虽说他如今实力还差家族年轻一辈第一人十万八千里，其它三府的人若是知道此事的话恐怕会不服，但他丝毫不担心，甚至有绝对的信心，只要经脉修复完毕，不出一年，就算无法赶超秦家年轻一辈第一，但是怕也相差不远了。

到时候，你不服？就揍到你服为止！
这一刻，接过‘离火钟’的秦轩，就如那表面不时流过的火焰一般，心中燃烧着一股熊熊大火，豪气万丈。
右手一翻，一本土黄色的羊皮卷出现在老祖的手中，羊皮卷一出，顿时散发出一股古老的气息，仿佛经历了无数的岁月一般，连秦轩都忍不住为之侧目。
“这是‘修身决’。”见到少年疑惑的目光，老祖笑着解释道，“老夫当年外出历练时意外获得，只可惜，这‘修身决’要求肉体的强度太高，老夫因无法修炼，所以一直将其搁置着，本以为会一直雪藏，没想到会有重见天日的一天。”
“你身体强度乃老夫生平仅见，你拿去好好研究一番，说不定对你经脉修复也有一定作用。”
双手接过那近乎残破的土黄色羊皮卷，秦轩郑重的点了点头，丝毫不矫情，虽然他不知道老祖到底看中他什么，又是重宝‘离火钟’，又是‘修身决’，但是他却将老祖的这份恩情铭记于心。
秦轩并非冷酷无情的人，相反的，他知恩图报，对于感情的重视比对于他自己的生命还要重几分！
“将你当日使用的大剑给老夫看看。”老祖突然说道。
点了点头，秦轩没有丝毫犹豫，从空间戒子中取出那被白布包裹住的巨大‘黑铁’。
双手轻轻的在‘黑铁’上抚摸而过，秦家老祖眼里有些微的惊讶，看着有些疑惑的少年，笑道，“看来你这小家伙的运气倒是不错，连灵器都被你找到了。”
“灵器！”
张了张嘴，秦轩显得有些惊讶，灵器虽说比不上重宝，但是也极少见到，说是万金难求也不为过，秦家四府中，也只有个别人才拥有灵器。
同阶中，拥有灵器的武者绝对比一般武者强上许多。
又是谈了几句，秦轩这才退了下去，龙阁很大，找个地方暂时住下并不难，又加上老祖有令，所以龙阁内的强者也并没有阻难。
盘坐于蒲团上，秦家老祖嘴角噙着一抹微笑，看着变得简陋的草屋，许久才轻声呢喃道，“还有当日的剑技，应该是高级剑法吧。”
“这次就让老夫看看你潜力到底有多大吧，十天应该够了……”

Chapter 11 The heavy treasure is obtained! (Second update please accept)
In the thatched house, the ancestor of the Qin family sat on a futon, frowning slightly, with a solemn look on his face, and doubts in his eyes from time to time. His hands with light blue light kept sweeping over the young man in black.
Qin Xuan also sat on the futon and observed the surroundings. What surprised him was that this seemingly ordinary thatched house was actually like a starry sky inside. The stars were so dotted that he seemed to be within reach. He sat in the starry sky, closed his eyes for a moment and felt it. He was surprised to find that the profound energy here was at least ten times stronger than the outside world!
The mysterious energy is ten times richer! What is this concept? Qin Xuan's scalp felt numb just thinking about it, but then his heart felt hot. If he stayed here, he might be able to break through to the Qi Sea realm in a short time, right?
"Weird, weird!"
Withdrawing his hands, the light blue light dissipated. The ancestor of the Qin family said two sentences in succession, his brows filled with confusion.
With a sharp tug in his heart, Qin Xuan didn't even have time to continue being shocked and quickly asked, "Ancestor, is there something wrong with my body?"
Seeing the young man's eager look, the ancestor shook his head, smiled bitterly, and said, "No, not only is your body fine, but your physical strength is far beyond my imagination."
Hearing this, Qin Xuan couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief, and then he became confused. If everything was fine, why did the ancestor look like this?
"After my observation, your meridians are indeed severed at more than seven levels. If you were an ordinary person, I am afraid you would have become a cripple and would be lying in bed for the rest of your life." Before the young man could speak, the ancestor continued, "Fortunately, you have a terrifying body."
The ancestor's voice could not conceal his surprise. If possible, he would even want to dissect the body and study it carefully.
Based on his observation, Qin Xuan's current body is already stronger than the average Qi Hai Jing strongman!
"Besides, if I'm not wrong, I'm afraid there is already a force in your body that is helping you repair your meridians, right?" The ancestor's last words were full of doubts, and he stared at the young man with his eyes, as if he wanted to see through him.
Slightly startled, Qin Xuan didn't expect that the ancestor could even discover this. He just hesitated and nodded, "Yes, but the repair is extremely slow."
"It's no wonder."
The ancestor of the Qin family looked as if he was like this and didn't ask too many questions. Everyone has their own opportunities, just like him back then. If he hadn't gotten something like that, he wouldn't have been able to build the entire Qin family single-handedly.
"Ancestor, is there something wrong with this power?" Qin Xuan frowned, and a bad premonition arose in his heart. That power naturally refers to the power of the 'Heroes' Codex', but if it were not for the 'Heroes' Codex', he would not have been able to advance to the third level in one day!
It is difficult for Qin Xuan to accept that there is something wrong with the 'Hero Divine Code'.
"That's not true." The ancestor smiled and shook his head. After thinking for a moment, the ancestor said, "From the current point of view, this power is not harmful to you."
"It's a pity that this power is too mysterious. I can't get a glimpse of it with my current strength." There was a wry smile on the corner of the ancestor's mouth. No matter how hard he tried before, he just couldn't break through the thick wall in the young man's body and see what was inside.
Seeing this, Qin Xuan finally calmed down, as long as the 'Divine Code of Heroes' was harmless to him. As for what his ancestor said about being unable to pry, it was actually easy to understand. After all, he got the 'Divine Hero Codex' from the mysterious universe. Not to mention the ancestor of the Qin family, even Qin Xuan himself knew very little about the 'Divine Hero Codex'.
However, this also made him look forward to the ‘Divine Heroes’ even more!
At this time, Qin Xuan suddenly noticed that the "starry sky" above his head was changing. Before he could react, he saw the ancestor of the Qin family reaching out to grab the "starry sky".
Like broken glass, under Qin Xuan's stunned expression, the entire 'starry sky' instantly shattered, revealing the original simple appearance of the thatched house, but in the hands of the ancestor, there was already a small crystal clear clock.
The reason why it is said to be small is mainly because the bell is only about the size of a palm, and its texture is like crystal. From time to time, a fiery red energy flows through the surface, like a flame. When it is closer, a hot breath rushes towards it.
The crystal clock was suspended in the air in the palm of the ancestor's hand, spinning slowly. From time to time, a powerful force overflowed, making Qin Xuan's soul tremble when he was close.
"This object is called the 'Lihuo Bell'." The ancestor smiled with a hint of reminiscence in his eyes, "I originally wanted to use it as a reward at this clan meeting, but now it seems that it has found a better owner."
"This, is this the important treasure?" Qin Xuan said in shock, his voice becoming a little sharp.
Nodding, the ancestor did not deny that he had more than just this important treasure, otherwise he would not be so grand. However, in order to fight for the 'Lihuo Bell', he also spent a lot of effort and was seriously injured to win it.
Qin Xuan couldn't help but take a breath of cold air, and his breathing became a little hurried. His eyes were fixed on the crystal clear 'Lihuo Bell' in front of him. This is a precious treasure! An existence that can cause quite a stir in the outside world!
At this time, Qin Xuan finally remembered why the thatched house looked like a starry sky before. He thought it was caused by this precious treasure, and the mysterious energy that was nearly ten times richer than the outside world. Since the starry sky disappeared and the 'Lihuo Bell' appeared in the hands of the ancestor, it also disappeared.
"Father once said that this precious treasure can not only repair meridians, but also increase the speed of cultivation. It seems that what he said is true."
Think about it, with a heavy treasure that is nearly ten times richer than the outside world's profound energy, how can you not practice faster?
"However, if you practice to the later realms, the effect will be smaller and smaller." Qin Xuan thought to himself, and understood that although external objects are important, oneself is the key, which is another reason why the ancestor contributed the 'Lihuo Bell'.
"It seems that boy Qin Yuntian has already told you."
Looking at the expression on the young man's face, the ancestor nodded with satisfaction and said with a smile, "I paid a huge price for this valuable treasure back then, and I relied on it to grow from the Qi Sea realm to the current realm. Now I give it to you, do you accept it?"
Although he had already guessed it, Qin Xuan was still full of excitement and excitement when these words came out of his ancestor's mouth. Don't you accept it? Unless your head is caught in the door or hit by a cannon!
This is a valuable treasure!
Before, he was a little worried about whether he could obtain this important treasure from his ancestor. After all, it was related to the repair of his meridians, and he also said at the clan meeting that only the first person in the younger generation of the family was qualified to obtain this object.
But now, Qin Xuan is completely relieved. Although his current strength is still far behind the number one in the younger generation of the family, and the people in the other three houses would probably be dissatisfied if they knew about this, he is not worried at all, and even has absolute confidence. As long as the meridians are repaired, within a year, even if he cannot catch up with the number one in the younger generation of the Qin family, I am afraid it will not be far behind.
When the time comes, you won’t accept it? I'll beat you until you surrender!
At this moment, Qin Xuan, who took over the 'Lihuo Bell', was like the flames flowing from time to time on the surface, with a raging fire burning in his heart, filled with heroic spirit.
Turning his right hand, a native yellow sheepskin scroll appeared in the hands of the ancestor. As soon as the sheepskin scroll came out, it immediately exuded an ancient aura, as if it had experienced countless years. Even Qin Xuan couldn't help but look at it sideways.
"This is the 'Moral Cultivation Art'." Seeing the young man's confused look, the ancestor explained with a smile, "I accidentally obtained it when I was out training. Unfortunately, this 'Morning Art' requires too high physical strength., I couldn't practice it, so I kept it on the shelf. I thought it would be hidden forever, but I didn't expect that it would see the light of day again. "
"Your physical strength is unprecedented in my life. If you study it carefully, it may also have a certain effect on the repair of your meridians. "
Taking the nearly broken earth-yellow sheepskin scroll with both hands, Qin Xuan nodded solemnly without any pretense. Although he didn't know what his ancestor saw in him, the important treasure "Lihuo Bell" and the "Cultivation Art", but he kept his ancestor's kindness in his heart.
Qin Xuan is not a ruthless person. On the contrary, he repays his kindness and values his feelings more than his own life!
“Show me the big sword you used that day. "The ancestor suddenly said.
Nodding, Qin Xuan took out the huge 'black iron' wrapped in white cloth from the space ring without any hesitation.
Gently stroking the 'black iron' with his hands, the ancestor of the Qin family was slightly surprised in his eyes. He looked at the confused young man and said with a smile, "It seems that you little guy is very lucky, you even found the spiritual weapon. "
"Spiritual weapon! "
Qin Xuan opened his mouth and looked a little surprised. Although spiritual weapons are not as good as heavy treasures, they are rarely seen. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is hard to find them. Among the four houses of the Qin family, only a few people have spiritual weapons.
At the same level, warriors with spiritual weapons are definitely much stronger than ordinary warriors.
After talking for a few more words, Qin Xuan retreated. The Dragon Pavilion was very big and it was not difficult to find a place to stay temporarily. In addition, the ancestor had orders, so the strong men in the Dragon Pavilion did not hinder him.
Sitting cross-legged on the futon, the ancestor of the Qin family had a smile on his lips. He looked at the shabby thatched cottage and murmured softly for a long time, "The sword skills of that day should be advanced sword skills. "
"Let me see how much potential you have this time. Ten days should be enough..."
